description: This Java class manages database connections and initializes database tables for a Derby database in a monolithic application.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Provides methods to obtain database connections, initialize database schema, and shutdown the Derby database.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns a new database connection using configured URL, user, and password.

methods.name: initializeDatabase
methods.description: Creates necessary tables if they do not exist, setting up the database schema.

methods.name: createTableIfNotExists
methods.description: Executes SQL to create a table if it does not already exist, ignoring specific error codes.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the Derby database connection.
